Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class Desktop2DAppRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.Desktop2DAppRegistry
public final class Desktop2DAppRegistry extends Object
Knows which of the desktop's applications the 2D desktop can run, and how.

Every start-menu descriptor carries a command string in one of the forms the 3D desktop understands (see AppLaunchAction):

  • java <mainClass> [args] - runs the class's main inside the desktop JVM. Most of these build a Java 3D window (Frame3D/Component3D) and therefore cannot run without 3D; the handful whose user interface is a plain Swing panel are hosted here in an internal frame instead.
  • swingapp <mainClass> [args] - same, plus 3D window capture. The capture step is meaningless in 2D, so only the in-JVM launch is done.
  • anything else - an external executable (firefox, xterm, javaws ...), started as a child process exactly as in 3D.

The Swing panels are looked up reflectively by name: lg3d-core cannot depend on lg3d-apps, and on a machine without 3D the app's wrapper class (which builds the Frame3D) must never be loaded - only its panel.

    • isExternalAvailable

      public static boolean isExternalAvailable(String command)
      True if an Desktop2DAppRegistry.Kind.EXTERNAL command's executable is on the PATH. The 3D start menu drops entries whose executable is missing; the 2D menu does the same so it never offers a button that cannot work.

    • createPanel

    • setCloseCallback

      public static void setCloseCallback(JComponent panel, Runnable onClose)
      Wires the panel's optional "Close" toolbar button to onClose, if the panel has one (setOnClose(Runnable)). Absent by design on panels that rely on the window decoration's close button.

    • showDate

      public static void showDate(JComponent panel, LocalDate date)
      Navigates a hosted panel to date, if the panel supports it (a public jumpToDate(LocalDate) method). Used by the taskbar calendar to open the Agenda at a double-clicked day; a panel without the method is left untouched. Reflective, like createPanel(java.lang.String, java.nio.file.Path), so lg3d-core keeps no compile-time dependency on the panel's module.

    • openFile

      public static boolean openFile(JComponent panel, File file)
      Opens file in a hosted panel, if the panel supports it (a public openFile(File) or openFile(Path) method). Used by the file-association launcher to hand a double-clicked document to the application the user chose for its type (for example the PDF Viewer); a panel without such a method is left untouched. Reflective, like createPanel(java.lang.String, java.nio.file.Path), so lg3d-core keeps no compile-time dependency on the panel's module.
      Returns:
      true if the panel reported that it opened the file

    • launchSwingFrame

      public static void launchSwingFrame(String command)
      Runs a Desktop2DAppRegistry.Kind.SWING_FRAME app's main inside this JVM on its own thread, as AppLaunchAction does in the 3D desktop. The swingapp verb's 3D window capture is deliberately skipped: there is no scene to capture into.

    • launchExternal

      public static boolean launchExternal(String command)
      Starts an Desktop2DAppRegistry.Kind.EXTERNAL command as a child process on the lg3d display, mirroring the 3D desktop's launcher.
      Returns:
      true if the process was started
